title: Microsoft Edge: switch between Workspaces inside one window
summary: Hold: the rollout checklist says Microsoft has not described tab behaviour during switching, although the roadmap describes tab swapping and Microsoft Support documents the switching steps. The release dates and both policy paths and registry settings are supported; the summary should distinguish a separate switching policy from the existing Workspaces control.

claims.claim: EdgeWorkspacesEnabled governs access to Workspaces as a whole, and disabling it prevents users accessing Workspaces.
claims.quote: If you enable or don't configure this policy, users can access the Microsoft Edge Workspaces feature. If you disable this policy, users won't be able to access the Microsoft Edge Workspaces feature.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not described how tabs behave when users switch Workspaces.

claims.fix: Replace the pilot bullet with: 'Pilot with a few Workspaces users to confirm sign-in state when they switch, since Microsoft has not described identity handling specifically for in-window switching.' The roadmap already describes tab swapping; https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/edge/getting-started-with-microsoft-edge-workspaces also documents selecting a Workspace to open it in the same window and using the Workspaces button to return to the Default window or switch again.
